productions.comment: Gamma vocabulary + admissibility for the fovea resolution: a FoveaResolver may hold FoveaCandidate options via `has_candidate`. This is the STRUCTURAL admissibility (Type-2 vocabulary) the checker C enforces -- without it, add_edge is rejected `Gamma rejects: type FoveaResolver not in vocabulary` (observed live: Gamma genuinely gates, it is not decorative). The PER-CANDIDATE consistency constraint (a fovea target must lie on an observed cell) is the on_valid==1 where-clause the fovea_resolve rule's Filter applies BEFORE weighting. weight defaults to Lit(1.0); grammar.rs's `selection proportional to exp(w)` is realised by the rule's ArgminUnique over Neg(w) (the MAP reading), w = Log(salience)+goal_logweight.

description: 160000 — THE FOVEA DECISION, MIGRATED Python->graph, resolved by the LOG-WEIGHTED ADMISSIBILITY GRAPH. 159000 proved salience-driven foveation but SELECTED the fovea with a numpy argmax/top-K in Python (scripts/salience_foveation_probe.py::select_fovea's `scored.sort(key=-peak)[:top_k]`) -- an agent DECISION in Python, forbidden by CLAUDE.md. This seed moves the SELECTION into the graph. grammar.rs: Gamma is the WEIGHTED ADMISSIBILITY grammar -- 'selection over admitted candidates is proportional to exp(w)', where the weight w is a Term. The deterministic (MAP) reading of `proportional to exp(w)` is argmax_w over ADMISSIBLE candidates = ArgminUnique(admissible-candidates, value=Neg(w)) -- the highest-log-weight admissible candidate, tie-refusing (a comparison can be false, a selection cannot: VISION_REFUSAL_CAPACITY / ArgminUnique). Ingest (mechanical world-adapter I/O, domains/fovea_bridge.py): the residual-salience field -> flag_movers -> connected components -> per-component peak/box (the SAME extraction select_fovea does BEFORE its sort) -> FoveaCandidate nodes edged `res -has_candidate-> c`, each carrying `salience` (bottom-up log-evidence source), `on_valid` (the Gamma admissibility datum), `goal_logweight` (top-down bias, default 0). NO Rust added -- composition of existing Terms (ArgminUnique/Filter/Neighbours/Log/Plus/Neg/Attr/Eq); engine stays `shared`, coarse path byte-identical, oracle 222/0.

rules.name: fovea_resolve
rules.comment: THE MIGRATED DECISION. For each candidate c of a resolver res, mark c as the fovea (is_fovea=1) IFF c is Gamma-admissible AND c IS the log-weighted admissible winner. The winner = ArgminUnique over the Gamma-ADMISSIBLE candidates (Filter on the admissibility where-clause GATES BEFORE weighting -- an inadmissible candidate never enters the fold, whatever its weight) keyed by Neg(w), w = Log(salience) + goal_logweight. w is the LOG-WEIGHT: Log(salience) is the bottom-up log-evidence (exp(w)=salience so selection is proportional to salience -- more salient => more likely the fovea, grammar.rs's exp(w)); goal_logweight is a CO-PRESENT top-down log-weight ADDED (log of a product of evidences) -- the override is a weight-SHIFT, continuous and monotone, NOT a switch. ArgminUnique REFUSES a tie (returns null) so two exactly-equal candidates yield NO fovea (fall back to coarse), never an arbitrary pick. Eq(Var c, winner) compares Value::Node by id, so exactly the one winning node is flagged. Idempotent (set_attr is_fovea=1; re-fire is a no-op at fixpoint) => self-terminating. admissible(x) := on_valid==1 is the DECLARED consistency constraint (Gamma where-clause: an `eye -foveates-> cell` edge is inconsistent if the cell carries no valid observation); no threshold, nothing tuned.
